items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He still is a very good friend of mine and also I, you know, often play with him

ctx.x: Okay, so that needs to be corrected … the Grove lists a quintet, as well. And you had personnel, was Gene and Jake first, or no?

No, the time when we had a quartet together, Jake was already, he‟d left school—I think he was playing with Woody‟s band—it could be, I think it was Woody Herman‟s band. It could be Maynard‟s [Ferguson], I‟m not quite sure about that part. But, so, Gene Cherico, always he had a knack for finding a drummer. We had a job in Hartford, a place called High Brein [sp??] Lounge—or Few Brein [sp??], I don‟t know how to pronounce it—it was a beer company or whatever. Anyway, we were looking for a drummer, Gene said, “Oh,…
